title: The Collected Works of C. G. Jung (Volume 4: Freud and Psychoanalysis)
summary: Twenty-volume collected edition translated by R.F.C. Hull under the editorship of Herbert Read, Michael Fordham and Gerhard Adler. Freud and Psychoanalysis, volume 4, contains most of Jung's published writings on Sigmund Freud and psychoanalysis from 1906-1916, covering the collaboration and the break.
